responsibility: Implements the RISC-V target hooks used by the D front end. It adds architecture/version identifiers such as `RISCV32` or `RISCV64` and hard- vs soft-float markers through `TARGET_D_CPU_VERSIONS`, and registers `__traits(getTargetInfo)` handlers that report target-specific properties like the selected floating-point ABI, making this file the D-language analogue of the C preprocessor builtin interface rather than a general code-generation component.
